articles.title: Theropods review - the joy of discovery without words
articles.summary: Theropods is a pixel-art point and click adventure set in prehistoric times of dinosaurs and cave-dwellers, and it proves you don't need words for a good time.

articles.title: Meta launches Muse Ember, a small AI model built for the repetitive work agents actually do
articles.summary: Meta has introduced Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient AI model to date. It's designed for the routine tasks AI agents handle all day: calling tools, handling small coding tasks, routing requests, extracting data, and processing long documents.

articles.title: JAMPACK’d Magazine – Issue #2
articles.summary: EposVox aka the Stream Professor has just opened pre-orders for the second issue of JAMPACK’d magazine – Physical media with a focus on 100% human-made, no-clickbait content.

articles.title: Robotic Car Charger Locks On With Suction
articles.summary: Not only does [Mew463]’s robotic car charger take care of plugging in his vehicle for him, it has some really clever features that are great to see in action.

articles.title: Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution
articles.summary: Meta Superintelligence Lab released a new AI model on Monday called Muse Ember, the lab’s lightest and most cost-efficient AI model yet. In its release, Meta said Ember was “designed for complex reasoning execution and the work agents repeat all day: tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, extraction, and long document parsing.”

articles.title: You Wouldn’t Download A Car…
articles.summary: His car little open top number with a body 3D printed ion PETG, and finished with a layer of carbon fibre. The styling is very organic, but maybe that windscreen needs a little work.

articles.title: Claude Code v2.1.321
articles.summary: Added --settings <file> to claude remote-control , which applies a settings file to every session it starts; if the file changes, no new session starts until you restart claude remote-control.

articles.title: Claude Fable 5.2 in GitHub Copilot
articles.summary: Claude Fable 5.2, Anthropic’s newest Fable model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. You can use it for complex, multistep coding tasks across large codebases.

articles.title: Here's What Apple Fixed in iOS 27.2.1 and macOS 27.2.1
articles.summary: The iOS 27.2.1 , iPadOS 27.2.1, and macOS 27.2.1 updates Apple released today fix a handful of security vulnerabilities. With the security fixes implemented, it's a good idea to update as soon as you can.

articles.title: Samsung bets that you’ll either buy a Galaxy S27 Pro or Ultra next year
articles.summary: In this case, Samsung isn’t actually betting next year’s S27 Ultra is going to surpass its predecessor by record numbers; rather, this is all about adding the S27 Pro as a fourth model for consumers to pick from .

articles.title: Fight through the districts of a dead city in the demo of SAMOPAL Protocol
articles.summary: With no identity and no past to rely on, your only goal is to get out. But as you fight your way through hostile environments, fragments of memory begin to surface — revealing that your survival may not have been a coincidence."

articles.title: Aftermind is a promising looking boomer-shooter set inside a coma patient's nightmares
articles.summary: Things look a bit spooky and full of gibs in the boomer-shooter Aftermind, set inside the mind of a coma patient. Another interesting upcoming game to stick onto your wishlist!

articles.title: iOS 27.3: Three new iPhone features coming soon
articles.summary: iOS 27.3 is currently in beta and packed with new features , here are three that will hit your iPhone when the update launches next month .

articles.title: Under-equipped and far from help, retro shooter DERELIKT arrives November 13
articles.summary: DERELIKT is a narrative retro FPS built for fans of claustrophobic PS1-era sci-fi horror, and it's set to release on November 13. Read the full article on GamingOnLinux .

articles.title: Apple releases iOS 26.7.3, watchOS 27.2.1, and more
articles.summary: Today Apple released a variety of software updates with the latest security fixes, including iOS 26.7.3 for iPhone, watchOS 27.2.1 for Apple Watch, and more.

articles.title: macOS 27.2.1 Fixes eMudhra Certificate Flaw in Command-Line Tools
articles.summary: Prior to releasing the macOS 27.2.1 update, Apple offered instructions for those who wanted to protect themselves from the compromised eMudhra certificates when using command-line tools, directing users to manually remove the affected root certificates from their Mac's "/etc/ssl/cert.pem" file.

articles.title: IWIBench: Evaluating Gradient-Free Model Driven Intra-weight Injection
articles.summary: Intra-weight injection lets one model change another model's behaviour by editing its weights directly, without gradients. Such edits can range from altering lexical associations to enforcing output formats or updating factual knowledge.

articles.title: Apple Releases macOS Golden Gate 27.2.1
articles.summary: Apple today released macOS Golden Gate 27.2.1, a minor update for the macOS Golden Gate operating system. macOS Golden Gate includes bug fixes and security updates, according to Apple's release notes.

articles.title: Firefox 160 release brings new floating ‘mini window’ mode
articles.summary: Firefox 160 released today with some new features. A new “Mini Window” option lets you move a tab or select a portion of a web page to an always-on-top window, so you can keep an eye on it while browsing.

articles.title: ChainFlow: Few-Step Latent Flow Matching for Speculative Decoding
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.08669v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Speculative decoding has become a standard way to accelerate LLM inference: a lightweight drafter proposes tokens that the target verifies in one parallel pass.

articles.title: Transporting the Past: An Optimal Transport View of Backtracking Counterfactuals
articles.summary: We study backtracking counterfactual inference for Structural Causal Models (SCMs) through the lens of optimal transport. In SCMs, a factual observation generally induces a posterior distribution over exogenous variables, making counterfactual inference inherently distributional.

articles.title: Cancellation Is Not Enough: What Retries Leave Behind in an Overloaded LLM Engine
articles.summary: Clients and proxies in front of an LLM engine retry calls that time out. After a transient overload, these retries can keep the engine from recovering even when calls arrive below its capacity.
